info.name: knowledge_graph
info.description:
Knowledge graph API on port 8001.

**E-com empty→live order (folder 0):**
1. GET health / empty checks
2. POST /ontologies (ecom — full schema + Zara/Primark/Matalan/C&A/Walmart)
3. POST /graphs (ecom_products, kind=product)
4. POST /api/sources (ecom_products, authorized_sql)
5. POST sync → poll job → metadata/values → query/retrieve

Bodies also in `postman/bodies/`. Guide: `knowledge_graph/POSTMAN.md`.

Auth: Bearer `{{apiToken}}` only if set. Always `X-Clearance: {{clearance}}` (internal).

item.name: 0 Ecom pipeline (empty → live)

request.description:
Evidence pack used by Fashion Brain.

**Input (BrainRetrieveRequest)**
- `question` string
- `intent` e.g. `product_count` | `specification` | `news` | `products` | `shared_products`
- `filters` object of catalog fields
- `group_by` string or null
- `analysis` bool — type-wise top tables/charts
- `suggest` bool — product specification sheet
- `limit`, `season_name`, `upcoming`, `corrections`

**Output (BrainRetrieveResponse)**
- `text`, `evidence[]`, `caveats[]`, `unavailable[]`, `synthetic_data`, `routes_hint[]`
